{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify the 6 rows with invalid revenue
invalid_rows = df[df['revenue'].isna()]

# Check the status of these rows
invalid_rows_status = invalid_rows['status'].value_counts()

# Check if any of these invalid rows are 'completed'
completed_invalid = invalid_rows[invalid_rows['status'] == 'completed']

# Check their order_ids
completed_invalid_order_ids = completed_invalid['order_id'].tolist()

completed_invalid_order_ids"}
